summary: Reduce the projects sync page size from 50 to 25 so the ProjectsQuery stays under Linear's GraphQL query-complexity cap.
reason: ProjectsQuery nests projectMilestones(first: 50) inside projects(first: N); Linear multiplies nested connection sizes when scoring complexity, so first: 50 scored ~12305 against the 10000 cap and every `sync` failed projects with HTTP 400 "Query too complex". Page size 25 scores ~6152; pagination still fetches every project.
validated_outcome: After the change `linear-pp-cli sync` reports `Syncing projects... 105` instead of the complexity error, and `milestones at-risk` / `initiatives health --data-source local` return data from the local store.
